description: This is a PHP source file defining the UserPreferencesController class which manages user preference settings related to rich text editor dimensions in a SuiteCRM environment. The class contains a method to save user preferences for text editor height and width via AJAX requests.

classes.name: UserPreferencesController
classes.description: Controller class handling user preference updates for text editor settings in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_save_rich_text_preferences
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to save user preferences for rich text editor height and width, returning the result as a JSON response.
